Interactive VetLit Summary

使用螺旋水充盈電腦斷層評估胃壁
Helical Hydro-CT for Stomach Wall Evaluation

空胃的胃壁厚度判讀容易失真。這篇研究把胃腔「水充盈」標準化，建立犬貓胃壁 hydro-CT 的實用流程：30 ml/kg 水 + 靜脈碘顯影。

30 ml/kgoptimal water volume
800 mgI/kgIV iodine dose
14/18abnormal clinical scans
403-405key technique pages
WhyProtocolFindingsCasesFiguresTake-home

為什麼這篇重要？

問題胃未擴張時，胃壁常因塌陷而看似增厚，造成假陽性或無法定位。
方法使用水作為中性胃腔內對比劑，避免陽性對比劑遮蔽胃壁顯影。
目標以 CT 評估胃壁增厚的真正位置、範圍、顯影型態與可能轉移。

Protocol builder

依研究流程整理成臨床可操作版本。

禁食與麻醉：研究中禁食 15 小時後麻醉；動物胸腹臥位，掃描範圍自心臟後緣至左腎。
胃管給水：建議 30 ml/kg 溫水。10 ml/kg 不足，20 ml/kg 在幽門區仍次佳，40 ml/kg 雖可完全擴張但 30 ml/kg 已足夠。
靜脈顯影：給予 800 mgI/kg 非離子碘顯影劑，研究中以 power injector 5 ml/s 注射，約 30 秒後開始掃描。
判讀重點：評估胃壁是否局部或瀰漫增厚、顯影是否不均質、黏膜是否高衰減、周圍脂肪/臟器侵犯與胃淋巴結。

影像特徵摘要

正常胃水充盈後胃壁變薄且可評估；顯影後黏膜中度均勻顯影。
腺癌局部中度胃壁增厚、不均質顯影、黏膜高衰減；本研究多見於小彎。
淋巴瘤可呈環狀或局部嚴重增厚，顯影中度且不均質。
平滑肌肉瘤單一病例為幽門竇內離散圓形腫塊，周邊顯影明顯。

Clinical cohort

結果數量意義
hydro-CT 異常胃壁14/18多數後續確認為胃腫瘤；病灶範圍容易評估。
histopath confirmed neoplasia13犬腺癌 8、犬低惡性平滑肌肉瘤 1、犬淋巴瘤 1、貓淋巴瘤 3。
正常胃壁且排除腫瘤4/18顯示 hydro-CT 可用於排除超音波疑似但可能因胃未擴張造成的假性增厚。
不良反應0本研究未偵測到程序相關不良反應。

Fig. 1 — 胃解剖定位與 CT 層面｜Stomach anatomy and CT level

中文：（A）胃的示意圖，以及（B）同一層面的橫切面 CT 影像。B，胃體；C，賁門；D，十二指腸；E，食道；F，胃底；MaC，大彎；MiC，小彎；P，幽門；PA，幽門竇；PC，幽門管。

English: (A) Drawing of the stomach and (B) transverse CT image at the same level. B, body; C, cardia; D, duodenum; E, esophagus; F, fundus; MaC, major curvature; MiC, minor curvature; P, pylorus; PA, pyloric antrum; PC, pyloric canal.

Fig. 2 — 正常犬 hydro-helical CT 水量試驗｜Normal dog water-volume trial

中文：（A-F）正常犬的 hydro-helical CT。（A）給水前的原生 CT。胃底部分充滿氣體（星號），因此該處胃壁可被評估。胃體、幽門竇與幽門管不含氣體或液體，因此無法充分評估胃壁。（B）給予 10 ml/kg 水後，只有胃底近端充分擴張。胃底遠端與胃體有輕度擴張，但皺襞仍彼此接觸。其他區域僅含極少量液體。（C）給予 20 ml/kg 後，胃底與大部分胃體已充分擴張。然而，在幽門部與胃體-幽門交界處，擴張程度仍不足以最佳評估胃壁。（D）給予 30 ml/kg 水後，擴張程度令人滿意。胃體與幽門部仍可見一些皺襞，但不互相重疊。（E）給予 40 ml/kg 水後，僅可見極少數皺襞。十二指腸內可見少量水（箭頭）。（F）給予顯影劑後，胃黏膜呈中度顯影。

English: (A-F) Hydro-helical CT of a normal dog. (A) Native CT before administration of water. The fundus is filled partially with gas (asterisk) which allows evaluation of the wall at that location. The body, pyloric antrum and pyloric canal do not contain gas or fluid preventing adequate evaluation of the gastric wall. (B) After 10 ml/kg of water administration, only the proximal part of the fundus is distended adequately. The distal part of the fundus and the body have a small degree of distension but the rugal folds are still in contact. The other parts contain only a minimal amount of fluid. (C) After 20 ml/kg, the fundus and most part of the body are distended adequately. However, in the pyloric part and at the junction between body and pylorus, the distension does not allow optimal evaluation of the gastric wall. (D) After administration of 30 ml/kg of water, the degree of distension is satisfactory. Some folds are still visible in the body and pyloric parts of the stomach but they do not overlap. (E) After administration of 40 ml/kg of water, only a few folds are visible minimally. A small amount of water is present in the duodenum (arrow). (F) After contrast medium administration there is moderate enhancement of the gastric mucosa.

Fig. 3 — 正常貓 hydro-helical CT 水量試驗｜Normal cat water-volume trial

中文：（A-F）正常貓的 hydro-helical CT。與犬相同，空胃（A）或給予 10 ml/kg 水後（B）無法評估胃壁；給予 20 ml/kg 水後（C）仍屬次佳。30 ml/kg 水（D）已足以診斷；40 ml/kg 時，所有皺襞皆消失。圖（E）與（F）顯示胃內給予 40 ml/kg 水後並加上顯影劑。十二指腸內可見水（箭頭）。

English: (A-F) Hydro-helical CT of a normal cat. As for the dog, the stomach wall evaluation was not possible with the stomach empty (A) or after administration of 10 ml/kg water (B) and suboptimal with 20 ml/kg water (C). Thirty milliliters per kilogram of water (D) was sufficient for diagnosis while with 40 ml/kg, all folds have disappeared. Figures (E) and (F) show the stomach after 40 ml/kg and plus contrast medium. Water within the duodenum is visible (arrow).

Fig. 4 — 犬胃癌的 hydro-CT 顯示｜Canine gastric carcinoma

中文：（A-B）一隻犬胃癌的 CT 研究：（A）空胃狀態的 CT。胃壁增厚，尤其在胃體大彎處，且胃體小彎的胃黏膜表面不規則。（B）同一隻犬於 30 ml/kg 水擴張胃腔並注射靜脈顯影劑後。胃體小彎處的增厚清楚可見（箭頭）。胃體小彎層面的胃壁增厚清楚可見（箭頭）。可見中度顯影。

English: (A-B) CT studies of a dog with a gastric carcinoma: (A) CT scan with the stomach empty. There is a thickening of the gastric wall, especially at the level of the greater curvature at the body, and an irregular surface of the gastric mucosa of the lesser curvature of the body. (B) Same dog after distension with 30 ml water/kg and injection of intravenous contrast medium. The thickening of the lesser curvature at the body is clearly visible (arrows). The thickening of the gastric wall at the level of the lesser curvature of the body is clearly visible (arrow). There is moderate contrast enhancement.

Fig. 5 — 貓胃淋巴瘤｜Feline gastric lymphoma

中文：（A-B）患有胃淋巴瘤的貓。（A）空胃的橫切面影像顯示胃壁呈環狀增厚。（B）給予 30 ml/kg 水後再施打靜脈顯影劑，可見胃底與胃體大彎處嚴重局部增厚，並呈中度顯影。可見胃管（箭頭）。

English: (A-B) Cat with gastric lymphoma. (A) Transverse image of an empty stomach-shows a circumferential thickening of the gastric wall. (B) After administration of 30 ml water/kg followed by intravenous contrast medium, a severe focal thickening of the greater curvature of the fundus and body with moderate contrast enhancement is visible. The gastric tube is visible (arrow).

Fig. 6 — 胃淋巴瘤與食道裂孔疝｜Gastric lymphoma with hiatal hernia

中文：（A-C）一隻患有胃淋巴瘤貓的 CT 重組影像。（A）矢狀面，以及（B、C）不同胃部層面的背側重組影像。可見胃底嚴重不規則增厚，並合併食道裂孔疝（短箭頭）。胃壁顯影為不均質且中度。可見胃管（長箭頭）。

English: (A-C) (A) Sagittal and (B, C) dorsal reconstructed CT images at different levels of the stomach in a cat with gastric lymphoma. Severe irregular thickening of the fundus with a hiatal hernia is present (short arrows). The enhancement of the gastric wall is heterogeneous and moderate. The gastric tube is visible (long arrow).

Take-home

臨床應用：當超音波或常規 CT 懷疑胃壁增厚，但胃未充分擴張導致判讀不確定時，helical hydro-CT 可作為更標準化的胃壁評估方式。
  1. 胃壁評估的先決條件是足夠擴張，否則厚度判讀不可靠。
  2. 30 ml/kg 是本研究建議的犬貓胃內給水量。
  3. 靜脈顯影是 staging 與病灶辨識的必要步驟。
  4. hydro-CT 可幫助 mapping，但不能取代病理診斷。
